SELECT player_id,
    season,
    games,
    toi_5v5_minutes,
    toi_pp_minutes,
    toi_pk_minutes,
    toi_total_minutes,
    evo_xgf60,
    evd_xga60,
    ppo_xgf60,
    ppd_xga60,
    pen_net60,
    minors_drawn,
    minors_taken,
    evo_xgf60_unadj,
    evd_xga60_unadj,
    gf_5v5,
    ga_5v5
   FROM player_gar_inputs_by_type
  WHERE game_type = 2;

WITH toi AS (
         SELECT player_toi_by_state.player_id,
            player_toi_by_state.season,
            citrus_game_type(player_toi_by_state.game_id::bigint) AS game_type,
            sum(player_toi_by_state.toi_seconds) FILTER (WHERE player_toi_by_state.state = '5v5'::text) AS s_5v5,
            sum(player_toi_by_state.toi_seconds) FILTER (WHERE player_toi_by_state.state = 'PP'::text) AS s_pp,
            sum(player_toi_by_state.toi_seconds) FILTER (WHERE player_toi_by_state.state = 'PK'::text) AS s_pk,
            sum(player_toi_by_state.toi_seconds) AS s_all,
            count(DISTINCT player_toi_by_state.game_id) AS games
           FROM player_toi_by_state
          GROUP BY player_toi_by_state.player_id, player_toi_by_state.season, (citrus_game_type(player_toi_by_state.game_id::bigint))
        ), onice AS (
         SELECT player_onice_xg.player_id,
            player_onice_xg.season,
            citrus_game_type(player_onice_xg.game_id::bigint) AS game_type,
            sum(player_onice_xg.xgf_flurry) FILTER (WHERE player_onice_xg.state = '5v5'::text) AS xgf_5v5,
            sum(player_onice_xg.xga_flurry) FILTER (WHERE player_onice_xg.state = '5v5'::text) AS xga_5v5,
            sum(player_onice_xg.xgf_flurry) FILTER (WHERE player_onice_xg.state = 'PP'::text) AS xgf_pp,
            sum(player_onice_xg.xga_flurry) FILTER (WHERE player_onice_xg.state = 'PK'::text) AS xga_pk,
            sum(player_onice_xg.xgf) FILTER (WHERE player_onice_xg.state = '5v5'::text) AS xgf_5v5_unadj,
            sum(player_onice_xg.xga) FILTER (WHERE player_onice_xg.state = '5v5'::text) AS xga_5v5_unadj,
            sum(player_onice_xg.gf) FILTER (WHERE player_onice_xg.state = '5v5'::text) AS gf_5v5,
            sum(player_onice_xg.ga) FILTER (WHERE player_onice_xg.state = '5v5'::text) AS ga_5v5
           FROM player_onice_xg
          GROUP BY player_onice_xg.player_id, player_onice_xg.season, (citrus_game_type(player_onice_xg.game_id::bigint))
        ), pen AS (
         SELECT z.player_id,
            z.season,
            z.game_type,
            sum(z.taken) AS taken,
            sum(z.drawn) AS drawn
           FROM ( SELECT player_penalty_events.committed_by AS player_id,
                    player_penalty_events.season,
                    citrus_game_type(player_penalty_events.game_id::bigint) AS game_type,
                    1 AS taken,
                    0 AS drawn
                   FROM player_penalty_events
                  WHERE player_penalty_events.duration_min = 2 AND player_penalty_events.committed_by IS NOT NULL
                UNION ALL
                 SELECT player_penalty_events.drawn_by,
                    player_penalty_events.season,
                    citrus_game_type(player_penalty_events.game_id::bigint) AS citrus_game_type,
                    0,
                    1
                   FROM player_penalty_events
                  WHERE player_penalty_events.duration_min = 2 AND player_penalty_events.drawn_by IS NOT NULL) z
          GROUP BY z.player_id, z.season, z.game_type
        )
 SELECT t.player_id,
    t.season,
    t.game_type,
    t.games,
    round(t.s_5v5::numeric / 60.0, 2) AS toi_5v5_minutes,
    round(COALESCE(t.s_pp, 0::bigint)::numeric / 60.0, 2) AS toi_pp_minutes,
    round(COALESCE(t.s_pk, 0::bigint)::numeric / 60.0, 2) AS toi_pk_minutes,
    round(t.s_all::numeric / 60.0, 2) AS toi_total_minutes,
    round(o.xgf_5v5 * 3600.0 / NULLIF(t.s_5v5, 0)::numeric, 4) AS evo_xgf60,
    round(o.xga_5v5 * 3600.0 / NULLIF(t.s_5v5, 0)::numeric, 4) AS evd_xga60,
    round(o.xgf_pp * 3600.0 / NULLIF(t.s_pp, 0)::numeric, 4) AS ppo_xgf60,
    round(o.xga_pk * 3600.0 / NULLIF(t.s_pk, 0)::numeric, 4) AS ppd_xga60,
    round((COALESCE(p.drawn, 0::bigint) - COALESCE(p.taken, 0::bigint))::numeric * 3600.0 / NULLIF(t.s_all, 0)::numeric, 4) AS pen_net60,
    COALESCE(p.drawn, 0::bigint) AS minors_drawn,
    COALESCE(p.taken, 0::bigint) AS minors_taken,
    round(o.xgf_5v5_unadj * 3600.0 / NULLIF(t.s_5v5, 0)::numeric, 4) AS evo_xgf60_unadj,
    round(o.xga_5v5_unadj * 3600.0 / NULLIF(t.s_5v5, 0)::numeric, 4) AS evd_xga60_unadj,
    o.gf_5v5,
    o.ga_5v5
   FROM toi t
     LEFT JOIN onice o USING (player_id, season, game_type)
     LEFT JOIN pen p USING (player_id, season, game_type)
  WHERE t.s_5v5 > 0;
